content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal replaces the over-long sentence rewrite with a single concise inserted Paragraph 9.10 that carries the complete preferred package — once per 12 months, 30 days' prior written notice, business hours, off-site where possible, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, no direct system access, and cost-shifting only on underpayment exceeding 5% — while leaving 9.8's favourable cost allocation and 9.9's F&ASC gate untouched. The official minimality gate and frequency check both pass.
